follow-up time: within the first week after birth
cohort: 1,279 very preterm infants (<32 weeks of gestation) admitted to a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Lower gestational age, vaginal delivery, ductus arteriosus and early onset sepsis were independent predictors of any IVH, while pulmonary hemorrhage, tension pneumothorax and early onset sepsis were independent risk factors for high-grade IVH.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was an independent predictor for any IVH.
